dict.string: Grapefruit connects to your Plex Media Server on your local network to browse libraries and sync playlists.
Grapefruit reads and writes music and playlists on your connected iPod or USB device.
Grapefruit reads the music files you point it at on your Desktop.
Grapefruit reads the music files you point it at in your Documents folder.
Grapefruit reads the music files you point it at in your Downloads folder.
